messages:
Nora (Marketing): Quick sync: Redwood x SummitCloud co-marketing for Edge Adapter. Scope: SummitCloud marketplace listing, short benchmark blog, 60-min webinar. Need ops checklist + inbound lead routing. Volunteers?
Ivy (Growth): I can run landing page + webinar ops. Proposed date: May 12 (midday PT).
Tomas (Demand Gen): Works for me if listing is live a week prior. Routing requirement: SFDC lead.source = summitcloud_marketplace.
Lee (Sales): Sales routing: assign to marketplace-queue, SDR owner Priya. Need sample webhook JSON to map fields.
Ravi (Product): Ian produce benchmark metrics: p95/p99 latency, throughput at batch sizes 1/8/16, cost/10k tokens. I'll drop raw numbers by EOD Tue.
Marketplace Bot: Listing status: partner review requested (https://summitcloud.example/review/edge-adapter).
Nora (Marketing): Landing CTA idea: "Deploy Redwood Edge Adapter 1 predictable cost". UTM: utm_source=summitcloud&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=edge-adapter.
Ivy (Growth): Form fields: name, email, company, role, cloud_region, use_case. Map to analytics as usual.
Tomas (Demand Gen): Planned flow: summit webhook -> EventBridge -> inbound lambda -> Segment -> SFDC. Lambda should enrich with Clearbit employee_count, set Lead.Owner=marketplace-queue and add tag partner:summitcloud. Flag leads with employee_count>25.
Lee (Sales): Priya prefers >25 employees flagged. Good.
Ravi (Product): Demo script: install adapter, 30s cold start, run seq=2048 bench, show cost calc. Example command: python bench.py --adapter=edge --model=redwood --seq=2048 --batches=100
Nora (Marketing): Ops checklist (draft): partner review due Apr 26; listing go-live Apr 30; landing page Apr 28; benchmark draft Apr 25; blog review May 2; lambda routing Apr 27; SDR playbook Apr 24; webinar May 12; post-webinar assets May 13.
Nora (Marketing): Please confirm one-line with the item you own + \u2705 so I can add to the calendar.
Tomas (Demand Gen): I own partner listing review + routing lambda sign-off \u2705
Ivy (Growth): I own landing page, webinar ops, speaker outreach, confirmation email \u2705
Ravi (Product): I own benchmark numbers, demo script, and slides \u2705
Lee (Sales): I own SDR playbook and triage rules \u2705
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: ops checklist reminder Apr 27 09:00 UTC.
